Role Overview We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Amazon FBA Sourcing & Operations Manager to oversee our Online Arbitrage (OA) supply chain and daily seller account health. In this consolidated role, you will be the gatekeeper for our capital—auditing leads, executing purchases, managing supplier logistics, and maintaining the operational health of our Amazon storefront.



Core Responsibilities

1. Lead Auditing & Sourcing Management

• Lead Verification: Manually audit 100% of the leads generated by Sourcing VAs against strict profitability criteria before approving them into the 3P Lead Vault and authorizing capital.

• Cost Analysis: Accurately calculate all add-on product costs, including inbound shipping, prep center fees, and Amazon FBA fees, to ensure true ROI targets are met.

• Lead Vault Re-Mining: Mine the historical Lead Database daily to identify previously non-performing leads that have shifted back into our profitability range due to market volatility.

• Buylist Preparation: Prepare Daily Buylists on 3P Mercury, organizing new ASINs from sourcing leads and identifying re-stocking opportunities based on historical sales performance and inventory velocity.



2. Purchasing & Supplier Management

• Supplier Validation: Thoroughly vet new suppliers to verify their legitimacy, stock availability, and shipping lead times to prevent tied-up capital.

• Order Execution: Execute orders strictly adhering to approved sourcing criteria, quantity limits, maximum cost-per-order, and daily spend limits provided by management.

• Documentation & Tracking: Complete purchases and immediately attach all receipts, invoices, and tracking numbers to the 3P master tracking system.



3. Logistics & Prep Center Coordination

• Reconciliation: Cross-reference supplier orders against prep center receiving reports to ensure 100?curacy.

• Issue Resolution: Follow up directly with suppliers to track missing orders or quantities. Identify damaged or mismatched stock, initiate return requests, and secure refunds.

• Routing: Coordinate shipping documentation, FNSKU labels, and carton labels directly with the prep center to ensure smooth transition of inventory into Amazon fulfillment centers.



4. Account Management & Health

• Inventory Management: Monitor stranded inventory, unfulfillable units, and restock limits.

• Account Health: Routinely monitor the Account Health Dashboard to proactively address and resolve IP complaints, authenticity claims (especially within gated categories), and negative feedback.

• Pricing Strategy: Oversee and adjust repricer settings to maintain Buy Box share and maximize margins.



Requirements & Qualifications

• Extensive experience working in an Amazon Online Arbitrage (OA) business model.

• Expert-level proficiency in reading and analyzing Keepa charts (sales rank velocity, buy box history, offer counts, and price history).

• Familiarity with standard Amazon seller software stack (e.g., 3P Mercury, ArbiSource, SellerBoard, Seller Snap).

• Bonus: Previous experience sourcing and managing compliance for the Beauty & Personal Care categories.

• Strong English communication skills for supplier outreach and team coordination.

title: Senior Sales Lead Generator
description:
I am hiring a senior lead generator who can be located globally to generate qualified discovery calls with founder-led and CEO-led SMEs in Australia and globally for my AI consulting business.



This is not a junior SDR role, not a generic appointment-setting role, and not a role for someone who needs hand-holding.



You will be responsible for identifying good-fit businesses, doing outbound prospecting, opening commercial conversations, qualifying decision-makers properly, and booking attended discovery calls that I will run and close.



If you need constant supervision, this is not the role.



If you are good at getting senior decision-makers into quality sales conversations and you want upside without being micromanaged, keep reading.



I will train you in how to use AI [I'm an expert in AI] and I will work with you to build AI automations to make your tasks more efficient and easier





## About the Business

I help founder-led and CEO-led SMEs adopt AI in practical, commercially sound ways that improve performance, reduce risk, and strengthen execution without turning the business into a technology experiment.



My work includes AI strategy, AI policy writing, AI training, readiness assessment, and implementation support for business owners and senior leaders who care about evidence, clarity, and execution discipline.



I am not a software vendor, reseller, generic online course provider, or big-consulting-style advisory firm.



The people I work best with are pragmatic leaders in services and professional services businesses who know AI matters but do not want hype, chaos, or random experimentation.





## What You Will Be Selling Into

Your first job is to create qualified meetings for one flagship offer: AI Foundations Training at $5,000.



This is a practical six-session online training programme delivered over two months for up to 10 participants, built around real work tasks rather than generic AI awareness content.



It is a strong fit when a CEO can see AI matters, staff are already using ChatGPT, Claude, or Copilot inconsistently, there is concern about poor usage or lack of structure, and leadership wants the team to use AI properly rather than casually. I position it as teaching your team AI skills so they can do more with less.





## Who You Will Target

You will prospect into Australia and global markets and can be located globally.



The ideal buyer is usually a founder, CEO, or managing director of a service-led SME with around 5 to 50 staff and roughly $1 million to $20 million in annual revenue.



Strong-fit businesses are usually service and professional services firms rather than product companies, enterprise organisations, or startups building AI products.



Poor-fit prospects include businesses looking only for software, generic AI awareness sessions, or technical build work rather than commercially grounded advisory and capability building.





## What You Will Actually Do

- Build your own lead list using LinkedIn,
, networking, and public signals rather than waiting for me to hand you a pipeline. I will work with you to automate parts of this using AI and you will co-work with AI.

- Research companies and decision-makers properly before outreach. I will work with you to automate parts of this using AI and you will co-work with AI.

- Use trigger events and commercial context to decide who is worth contacting now. I will work with you to automate parts of this using AI and you will co-work with AI.

- Reach out to founders, CEOs, and managing directors with tailored messages that show you understand their likely AI situation. I will work with you to automate parts of this using AI and you will co-work with AI.

- Start conversations around the right business problem, not generic “AI is the future” noise.

- Qualify whether the prospect fits the ICP, has a real business problem, has some timing urgency, and is likely able to buy.

- Book attended discovery calls with decision-makers and hand them over cleanly.

- Record outreach, notes, status, and relevant context accurately inside my CRM.

- Stay away from bad-fit leads that waste time, including enterprise firms, software shoppers, and people with no decision authority.



## What Good Looks Like

You are not being measured on busywork, activity theatre, or whether you “look busy” online.



You are being measured on outcomes.



The main target is 12 attended qualified meetings per month with founder, CEO, or MD-level decision-makers who fit the ICP and are worth my time.



A qualified meeting means the person attended, has decision-making authority, fits the business profile, and has enough budget, timing, and business pain to justify a serious discovery conversation.



## Must-Have Skills



- Strong written English and commercially credible business communication.

- Real experience in outbound prospecting, appointment setting, or B2B meeting generation.

- Confidence contacting senior decision-makers directly.

- Good judgment about fit, timing, and whether a lead is worth pursuing.

- Ability to personalise outreach using real business context instead of spraying templates.

- Discipline to update CRM notes and handover information properly.

- Comfort using LinkedIn,
, and basic AI support tools without relying on AI to think for you.

- Enough maturity to work without fixed hours, daily chasing, or emotional neediness.



## Strong Advantage

You will stand out if you have a understand how to prompt AI.

You will stand out if you have sold or opened conversations into founder-led service businesses before.



You will also stand out if you understand professional services buyers, know how to talk to owners without sounding like a script, and can spot public signals that show when AI training is timely.



## Who This Role Is For



You are likely a fit if you are commercially sharp, self-directed, calm under pressure, and comfortable owning your own results.



You do not need a manager standing over you.



You do need to know how to create opportunity from cold or lightly warm conditions.



You are probably not a fit if you want guaranteed pay for low-quality activity, struggle with rejection, or need a heavily structured employee environment.



## Working Style



Can be located globally.



Remote-first.



Flexible working style.



Results-driven.



A mix of LinkedIn,
, and networking outreach, with judgment on what gets the result.



Some tools may be provided, but I expect you to bring capability, not excuses.



You must record outreach and notes in my CRM properly.



You must not represent competing AI consulting offers while working with me.



## Commercial Terms



The is base salary is $350 USD



For the initial phase, commission is tied to AI Foundations Training only.



You will earn $500 AUD per closed AI Foundations Training deal once the client’s first invoice has been paid. Our target is 4 closes per month [$2000 AUD comissions]



Commission is payable on any AI Foundations deal from that account that closes within 30 days of the meeting booking date.



Commission will be paid within 14 days of receipt of the client’s first invoice payment. If you prove you can consistently deliver good-fit opportunities for AI Foundations Training, I am open to negotiating commission arrangements for other services I offer later.



## First 60 Days



The first review point is at 60 days.



By then, I should be able to see whether you can source the right types of accounts, open credible conversations, book attended qualified meetings, and keep clean CRM records.



If the meetings are weak, unqualified, or mostly no-shows, this will not work.



If the meetings are good and the commercial logic is sound, there is room to build from there.



## How to Apply



Send me the following:



1. A short introduction in clear English.

2. A brief summary of your experience in outbound prospecting, appointment setting, or booking B2B meetings with senior decision-makers.

3. A short list of the channels and tools you have used, especially LinkedIn and
.

4. One example of a personalised outbound message you would send to the CEO of a professional services firm where staff are already using AI informally and leadership likely needs structure.

5. A short explanation of how you decide whether a lead is qualified before booking a meeting.

6. A short note on why role suits you.

Credit repair is the front door. Funding is the bigger door behind it.

Our clients come in with damaged credit. We help them clean it up. Then we help them

access business loans, personal funding, and capital for the goals they couldn't reach

before — homes, businesses, real estate investments.



We're currently at $10K/month recurring revenue with an 8-person team (operations side

is Philippines-based, like you'd be). We're hiring the person who will help us scale

to $50K/month, then $100K, then $500K.



Our stack: GoHighLevel, Stripe, Make.com, Zapier, Meta Business Manager, ManyChat, Smart Credit, Skool, Slack, Notion.

COMPENSATION + GROWTH

We start every hire at $800/month because we test work ethic and proactivity first,

OUR HIRING PROCESS

title: Social Media Content Producer *Superstar Only*
description:
We're hiring a Social Media Content Producer to own the daily execution, publishing, and production operations behind our short-form content engine across Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. This is the hands-on execution role on the social team. You take creative direction and turn it into finished, polished, published content - fast, clean, and on-brand, every single day.



You will be working directly with a creator who has over 4 million followers across platforms, with Instagram as the primary channel. Our content operation is structured like a studio with batch production, performance metrics, and AI-native systems. You report to the Content Strategist who sets the creative direction and generates the ideas. Your job is to bring those ideas to life - editing, designing, scheduling, publishing, tracking performance, and keeping the entire production machine running smoothly.



This is a full-time remote position. We are looking for a fast, detail-oriented executor who can produce high-quality short-form content at volume, manage publishing workflows across multiple platforms, and actively use AI tools to increase speed and output. A genuine interest in health, beauty, and strong visual aesthetics is essential - this is the world we operate in, and you need to live and breathe it.



Responsibilities

- Produce 2 to 3 short-form videos and supporting graphics per day, including editing, trimming, captioning, and polishing content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

- Execute on creative briefs and direction provided by the Content Strategist, turning concepts into finished, platform-ready assets.

- Design on-brand visuals such as carousels, text graphics, thumbnails, and infographics that support the creator's style and messaging.

- Plan, schedule, and publish short-form content across all platforms while maintaining a balanced mix of educational, inspirational, and trend-based formats.

- Follow short-form trends including audio, hooks, captions, and editing styles, and flag relevant opportunities to the Content Strategist.

- Monitor performance metrics weekly and provide insights, recommendations, and data summaries based on watch time, retention, views, and engagement.

- Source and organize trending sounds, audio, and reference content to support the Content Strategist's ideation process.

- Coordinate collaboration posts and identify smart opportunities for creator crossovers and partnership content.

- Keep systems clean in Asana and Google Drive, ensuring clear task ownership, file naming, version control, and a predictable content runway.

- Use AI tools to streamline editing, captioning, clipping, and repurposing workflows to increase daily output and reduce turnaround time.

- Continuously improve and document production workflows to increase the efficiency and scalability of the content system.



Requirements

- 3+ years of experience creating and publishing short-form content for Instagram, TikTok, and/or YouTube Shorts with proven results.

- Genuine interest in health, beauty, and aesthetics. You naturally follow this space, understand the visual standards, and have an eye for what looks premium.

- Editing and design expertise in short-form video editing using Premiere Pro, CapCut, or Final Cut, and strong design ability using Canva or Photoshop, including thumbnails, carousels, text graphics, and supporting visuals.

- Strong ability to take creative direction and execute it accurately and quickly with minimal revision cycles.

- Deep platform fluency across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and emerging formats, with a clear understanding of distribution mechanics and platform culture.

- Experience managing posting schedules and publishing workflows across multiple platforms, with strong attention to detail, file organization, and systems management.

- Ability to track and interpret performance metrics such as watch time, retention, views, and engagement, and surface insights to inform strategy.

- AI-forward operator who actively uses AI tools in editing and production workflows. Bonus for familiarity with tools such as Runway, VEO or Flow, ChatGPT, or Claude.

- Excellent communication skills for collaborating with the Content Strategist, editors, and cross-functional teams.

- Ability to handle multiple tasks effectively while operating in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.

- Must submit a strong portfolio demonstrating editing, design, and creative execution across multiple short-form formats.

- Recognized for exceptional achievements such as attaining Latin Honors (Summa Cum Laude, Magna Cum Laude, Cum Laude), performance awards, or demonstrating fast career progression into higher roles.



Results

- Social content consistently published within 24 to 48 hours of long-form production wrap.

- Sustained growth in high-quality engagement including shares, saves, retention, and audience sentiment.

- A cohesive, premium social presence that reinforces and amplifies the creator's broader ecosystem.

- Clean, organized production systems with predictable output and minimal missed deadlines.



Requirements for Effective Remote Work

- Reliable computer or laptop capable of video editing.

- High-speed internet connection plus backup.

- Conducive work environment.



Working Schedule

- Full-time remote position.



Compensation

- Salary will be based on skills, speed, portfolio output, and experience.



Benefits

- Competitive salary.

- Paid Time Off from day one, increasing to 10 days annually after six months with the company.

- Training and development opportunities.

- Opportunity to contribute to a rapidly expanding content team producing world-class creator content.

- Great potential for career advancement into leadership positions.

title: Section 8 Assistant Property Manager
description:
Section 8 Assistant Property Manager



Job Type: Full-Time



Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM Central Time, with a 30-minute break



Salary: $1,000/month



Job Overview: 



We are seeking a detail-oriented and resident-focused Section 8 Assistant Property Manager (APM) to support the daily operations of affordable housing communities operating under HUD and Section 8 guidelines. The ideal candidate will assist with property administration, resident relations, compliance management, leasing activities, delinquency collection from housing assistance programs and residents, and coordination with internal teams to ensure high-quality service and regulatory compliance.



The Section 8 APM will work closely with the Property Manager to maintain occupancy, support resident retention, ensure accurate documentation, manage delinquency follow-up and collections, and uphold all affordable housing program requirements.



Key Responsibilities:



Resident Relations & Customer Service

Serve as a primary point of contact for Section 8 applicants, residents and housing authority offices.

Assist residents with questions related to Section 8 documents, payment receipts/follow up and coordinating housing officials inspections.

Respond promptly and professionally to resident concerns and housing agency requests.

Support resident retention initiatives and promote positive community engagement.



Affordable Housing Compliance

Assist with annual and interim recertifications/inspections in accordance with HUD and Section 8 regulations.

Verify, and maintain Section 8 payments have been received, follow up with housing offices for unpaid accounts.

Ensure resident files are complete, accurate, and audit-ready.

Maintain compliance with Fair Housing laws, HUD requirements, and company policies.

Monitor lease renewals, notices, and occupancy reporting - this person will also be responsible for ensuring renewal rental rate approval from the housing office prior to lease renewals.



Leasing & Occupancy Support

Receives RFTA Packages, sends to PM for completion and signing then sends back to the appropriate housing office.

Maintain applicant records according to regulatory requirements.



Administrative & Financial Duties

Support rent collection efforts from the housing authority and monitor delinquency reports.

Assist with data entry, reporting, and maintaining property management software.

Process resident correspondence and notices

Maintain updated contact information for the housing authority offices by region

Assist and maintain any additional administrative duties as needed to complete the Section 8 processing task.



Property Operations Support

Confirm/coordinate with Property Manager regarding unit readiness PRIOR to a resident moving in and during the RENEWAL INSPECTION process.



Required Skills:

Minimum of 1–2 years of property management, affordable housing, or customer service experience.

Knowledge of HUD, Section 8, LIHTC, or other affordable housing programs preferred.

Strong understanding of Fair Housing regulations.

Excellent organizational, communication, and customer service skills.

Proficiency in Google Docs and Appfolio property management software.

Ability to manage confidential information with professionalism and discretion.

Strong attention to detail and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.



Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with Appfolio, Google Sheets.

Bilingual skills are a plus.

Core Competencies:

Communication and interpersonal skills

Attention to detail

Regulatory compliance awareness

Problem-solving abilities

Time management and organization

Team collaboration

Resident-focused service approach



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

— Not client-facing account management (founder handles client communication)

— Not a graphic design or landing page development role

— Not an autonomous role on day one — you earn expanded ownership through demonstrated performance



How We Work: The Approval Model

This is important to understand before you apply. We manage significant client ad spend, and every dollar matters. Our workflow operates on an analysis-first, approval-before-execution model:



— Identify — You find the issue or opportunity in the data (waste, underperformance, untapped keyword, bid gap, etc.)

— Analyze — You quantify the impact, pull the supporting data, and document your reasoning

— Recommend — You present the recommendation to the founder with the evidence that supports it

— Execute — After approval, you implement the change and track the result



Routine maintenance tasks (search term negatives, bid adjustments within established guardrails, ad copy fixes) will have pre-approved parameters you can act on independently. Structural changes — campaign restructures, budget shifts, new campaign launches, conversion action changes — always require approval. This workflow is designed to protect the client and build mutual trust. Candidates who find this restrictive are not the right fit. Candidates who recognize this as a structured path to full ownership are.



Tools You Will Use

You must be proficient in the core paid media toolset. Training provided for agency-specific workflows and internal tools.



— Google Ads — Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Demand Gen (required)

— Microsoft Ads (required)

— Google Analytics 4 / GA4 (required)

— Google Tag Manager (required)

— Google Merchant Center (required)

— Google Sheets / Docs / Drive (required)

— Google Ads Editor + Microsoft Ads Editor (strongly preferred)

— Salesforce or equivalent CRM (familiarity preferred — for conversion pipeline understanding)

— Slack (daily communication)

— Asana (task management tool familiarity — Asana preferred)



Must-Haves

— Minimum 2 years managing Google Ads accounts with significant monthly spend ($10K+/month, higher preferred)

— Hands-on experience with Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaign types

— Strong understanding of conversion tracking: Google Tag, GA4 events, GCLID attribution, Enhanced Conversions, and offline conversion imports

— Experience building and maintaining negative keyword strategies at scale

— Ability to analyze campaign data at the keyword, product, ad group, device, geographic, and landing page level and draw actionable conclusions

— Experience with Google Ads Editor for bulk changes

— Working knowledge of Google Merchant Center and product feed optimization

— Microsoft Ads experience (campaign management, import from Google, UET tracking)

— Strong analytical skills — you think in ROAS, CPA, and margin, not just clicks and CTR

— Ability to write clear analysis summaries and document recommendations before execution

— Strong written English — you will present findings and recommendations in writing regularly

— Available Monday–Friday with at least 3–4 hours of overlap with US Eastern 9 AM–1 PM

— Detail-oriented and process-driven — mistakes on a $1M account are expensive

— Reliable internet connection with a backup plan



Nice-to-Haves (Not Required, But You Will Stand Out)

— Experience managing $50K+/month in ad spend across Google and Microsoft

— Experience with B2B lead generation campaigns (not just e-commerce)

— Familiarity with Salesforce conversion pipelines and offline conversion tracking

— Experience with Dynamic Number Insertion (DNI) for call tracking

— Google Ads certification (Search, Shopping, or Measurement)

— Experience managing multi-brand or multi-storefront accounts with cross-campaign coordination

— Familiarity with landing page testing and CRO principles

— Background in agency environments managing paid media across multiple client accounts

— Experience with auction insights analysis and competitive share-of-voice reporting



Hours & Working Style

— Starts part-time: 15–25 hours per week, with a clear path to full-time as you take on day-to-day management and additional client accounts

— Long-term engagement — we are building a paid media function inside a growing agency

— Consistent daily availability required — ad accounts need monitoring, not sporadic large blocks

— At least 3–4 hours daily overlap with US Eastern 9 AM–1 PM for real-time collaboration and approvals

— Clear, proactive communication is non-negotiable — if something looks wrong in the data, flag it immediately

— You will work alongside the founder (strategy, client relationships, approvals) and coordinate with our SEO and execution teams on cross-channel priorities



What We Offer

We treat contractors like tea
mbers. After a 90-day evaluation period, you become eligible for the following perks:



— Prorated 13th Month Payment — Paid in December or at year-end close, prorated based on months actively engaged after eligibility.

— Paid Time Off — 40 hours (5 days) of PTO upon successful completion of the 90-day evaluation period. After one full year of engagement, this increases to 80 hours (10 days) annually.

— Sick / Emergency Time — Reasonable notice required. Specific terms defined during onboarding.

— Remote Work Allowance — $25 to $50 USD/month to support your internet, power, and workspace costs. Exact amount confirmed in writing based on performance and continued engagement.

— Recognized Holidays — Blended Philippine and US holiday calendar agreed upon during onboarding.

— Performance Bonus — Discretionary and based on quality, reliability, output, client impact, and role-specific KPIs.

— Full-Time Conversion — Strong performers during the evaluation period will be offered a transition to full-time hours with expanded scope and additional client accounts.



90-Day Evaluation Period: The first 90 days are a mutual evaluation period. During this time, we assess reliability, analytical quality, turnaround time, communication, attention to detail, and ability to work within our approval workflow. Contractor perks and full-time consideration begin after successful completion of this period.



How to Apply

Please start your proposal with the word ROAS so we know you read the full post.



In your proposal, please answer the following:



1. You open a Google Ads account and see that Performance Max campaigns are spending 40% of budget at a 1.85x blended ROAS, but the top 5 campaigns averaged 2.77x while the bottom 4 averaged 0.55x. All PMax campaigns were paused by a previous manager. What is your approach?

2. An e-commerce account has only 117 negative keywords and you find $131K in spend on 3,100+ search terms with zero conversions. Walk us through how you would prioritize and build the negative keyword list.

3. Are you comfortable in a role where you present analysis and recommendations to the founder for approval before making changes, especially in the first 90–180 days?



If you have case studies, audit samples, or screenshots showing Google Ads performance improvements you contributed to, please include them. We are especially interested in seeing how you think through account problems, not just before-and-after numbers.

-Deliver on time, every time, do not try to "run up the clock" by intentionally working slowly (that being said, I do want you to work at a pace that feels reasonable and good for you)

- Google Sheets / Google Drive

-Familiarity with US online furniture and décor retailers (Wayfair, West Elm, CB2, Article, Room & Board., Pottery Barn, etc.)

-Canva

-Rate: $15 USD/hr for the right candidate

-Hours: Weekly hours will vary until mid-July when service is launched, with a more consistent weekly hourly commitment once service is live

-Location: Remote / Work from home

-Schedule: can work asynchronously, during the hours that suit your schedule best; reliable turnaround is expected



How This Hiring Process Works:

I am running paid trial projects with 2–3 candidates before selecting who joins me at launch in mid-to-late July. I'm also building a short list of trusted candidates to reach out to as my team grows - so if you're excellent, there is a real path forward even if you're not the first hire.

title: Maintenance Coordinator - Bilingual
description:
PSB (Pro Services Boston) and Green Ocean Property Management are integrated maintenance + property management teams serving the Greater Boston market. We manage multifamily, single-family, and HOA assets and run an in-house service operation focused on speed, quality, and clear communication.



Role Overview:

The Maintenance Coordinator is the command center for all work orders: intake, triage, scheduling, vendor coordination, tenant communications, and close-out. You’ll prioritize urgent issues, keep preventive maintenance on cadence, and drive down cycle times. This is a performance role with clear SLAs, daily accountability rhythms, and growth into senior coordination/ops leadership.



Core Responsibilities:

Work Order Intake & Triage

Receive requests via portal/phone/email; log with complete scope, photos, access info, and priority tag.

Classify by Priority (P0–P3) and building/owner rules; verify warranty/recall/recurring issues.

Pre-diagnose to reduce truck rolls (simple resets, filter sizes, breaker checks, shutoff guidance).

Scheduling & Dispatch

Assign to the right vendor/tech based on trade, SLA, geography, availability, and cost.

Build and update daily/weekly schedules; confirm tenant access, lockbox codes, pet/alarms, parking.

Create and track Not-to-Exceed (NTE) amounts; obtain approvals when required.

Vendor Management

Coordinate licensed vendors (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, appliance, roofing, etc.).

Ensure COI/W-9/licenses are current; validate arrival/completion, photo proof, and written diagnosis.

Request quotes for >NTE jobs; compare scope/price; route to approval.

Tenant & Owner Communication

Provide clear ETAs, prep steps (water shutoff, clearing access), and progress updates.

Set expectations for parts lead times and follow-ups; confirm satisfaction at completion.

Escalate sensitively when work impacts health/safety or habitability.

Preventive Maintenance (PM)

Maintain seasonal PM calendars (boilers/furnaces, gutters, dryer vents, smoke/CO checks, filter changes).

Batch/schedule PMs to minimize tenant disruption and travel time; track completion.

Invoicing & Close-Out

Ensure work orders have diagnosis, materials, labor, before/after photos, and time stamps.

Match invoices to WOs, verify against NTE, route exceptions, and submit to accounting the same day.

Emergencies & After-Hours Coordination

Follow the P0/P1 emergency SOP (gas/water/electrical hazards, no-heat, lockouts).

Coordinate on-call vendors, city services, and temporary mitigation.

Reporting & Quality

Produce daily/weekly reports on SLA adherence, WIP aging, cost variance, and vendor performance.

Flag repeat issues, recommend root-cause fixes (access hardware, part stocking, vendor changes).

Qualifications:

Fluent in English and Spanish language

Maintenance coordinating experience in a US Property Management company is a must

Knowledgeable in construction engineering is a plus

Has excellent problem solving skill

Good communication skills in English

Outstanding skills in organizing schedules

Experience with property management software Buildium/Property Meld is a plus

Self-driven and can work with little supervision

Extremely organized and can work in a constantly changing and fast past environment

Want to have a stable career with endless potential for learning and growth

Able to work on EST Business hours

title: E-Commerce Video Editor

, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. You'll own each ad from raw files to final export, cut multiple hooks and angles for testing, and iterate quickly based on performance data. This role suits a fast, detail-oriented editor who thinks like a marketer, takes feedback well, and gets genuinely excited when a new hook beats the control.

Important: We hire editors who treat ads as conversion tools, not showreels. Our priority is selling personalized gifts to real people on their phones short-form, native, hook-first. – Edit short-form video ads (15–60 seconds) for
, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, focused on driving conversions for our personalized gift products.

nt behind each gift.

– Adapt every ad to the right aspect ratio for placement testing (9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9), keeping framing, captions, and pacing right for each.

– Apply solid post-production craft: color, audio mixing, captioning, speed ramps, transitions, and clean dynamic text overlays.

– Build ads using direct-response structures, strong hook in the first 3 seconds, a clear angle, and a natural call to action.

– Source and edit licensed music, sound design, and voiceovers that fit the ad without distracting from the product.

– Review ad performance with the marketing team (hook rate, CTR, ROAS) and use the data to shape the next round of iterations.

– Maintain a clean, organized asset library across Drive, 
, or similar so footage, fonts, and brand assets stay reusable across brands and campaigns.

Qualifications

– Demonstrated success on Meta and TikTok ads, examples of ads that actually ran, performed, and were iterated on (not just one-off creative).

– Strong eye for visual storytelling, product presentation, and pacing for mobile-first viewing.

– Comfortable producing many variations from one set of footage without losing quality or attention to detail.

– Able to work independently, manage your own queue, and ship on tight turnarounds (24–48 hours for first cuts).

– Open to occasional weekend coverage during peak seasons like Q4, and holidays.

– Excellent communicator with strong follow-up across designers, media buyers, and operations.

– Time management and attention to detail, especially across multiple ad variations.

– Open and receptive to feedback, with a collaborative and team-oriented mindset.

– Calm under pressure during launch windows and peak seasons.

– Curious, eager to learn, and quick to pick up new tools and trends.

– Proactive and process-driven, with a passion for continuous improvement.

– Hands-on mentality with a strong drive to ship.

Nice-to-Have



– Adobe After Effects

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Role Overview



We are looking for a reliable graphic designer to work with MDG Beverages on an ongoing freelance or part-time basis.



The main responsibility will be creating and refining label designs for bottles, cans, gift boxes, and other beverage packaging. We will often provide the concept, rough design direction, brand name, logo, colours, reference images, dielines, and required legal information. Your role will be to turn those ideas into polished, professional, print-ready Adobe Illustrator files.



You must be confident working with .ai files, printer dielines, bleed, safe zones, CMYK colour setup, foil layers, spot colours, and export formats required by commercial printers.



?



Key Responsibilities



* Take label concepts and creative direction from MDG Beverages and develop them into professional label designs.

* Create print-ready Adobe Illustrator .ai files for commercial label printing.

* Work from supplied dielines, templates, bottle/can dimensions, and printer specifications.

* Ensure all artwork includes correct bleed, trim lines, safe zones, and print setup.

* Prepare artwork for different print finishes, including foil, clear foil, spot colours, varnish, and premium label stocks where required.

* Adapt existing label templates into new brand or product designs while keeping the correct structure and legal information.

* Ensure all mandatory label details are included, such as:

    * Pregnancy warning label

    * Alcohol by volume, for example 40?V

    * Bottle or can volume, for example 750ml or 330ml

    * Standard drinks information

    * MDG Beverages company name and address

    * Batch numbers, barcode spaces, and other required label information where supplied

* Create mockups for approval, including bottle, can, box, and flat label previews.

* Make revisions quickly and accurately based on feedback.

* Maintain strong brand consistency across product ranges.

* Supply final files in the required formats, including .ai, print-ready PDF, PNG/JPEG mockups, and packaged files with linked assets where needed.

* Liaise with printers or follow printer artwork instructions when required.



?



Skills Required



The ideal candidate must have strong experience with:



* Adobe Illustrator

* Adobe Photoshop

* Print-ready packaging artwork

* Label design

* Beverage, alcohol, FMCG, cosmetics, or premium product packaging

* Dielines and commercial print setup

* CMYK colour setup

* Bleed, trim, safe zones, and crop marks

* Typography and layout

* Logo placement and brand consistency

* Preparing artwork for foil, spot colour, varnish, and special finishes

* Creating realistic product mockups



Experience with alcohol, wine, spirits, RTD, beer, or food and beverage packaging would be highly valued.



?



What We Will Provide



MDG Beverages will usually provide:



* Brand or product concept

* Product name

* Logo or reference logo

* Label template or dieline

* Bottle or can dimensions

* Legal label information

* Reference images or moodboards

* Printer specifications

* Colour direction

* Written feedback and revision notes



?



What We Need From You



We need someone who can:



* Understand a creative concept quickly

* Follow instructions carefully

* Keep the label structure accurate

* Not alter dielines unless requested

* Pay attention to small details

* Prepare files properly for printers

* Communicate clearly

* Turn around work efficiently

* Be comfortable working across multiple beverage brands under the MDG Beverages umbrella



?



Example Projects



You may be asked to design or prepare artwork for:



* Premium gin labels

* Vodka labels

* Rum and whisky labels

* RTD can labels

* Limited edition alcohol labels

* Corporate gifting bottles

* Event collaboration bottles

* Batched cocktail labels

* Gift boxes and packaging

* Neck tags, stickers, cartons, and promotional material



?



File Requirements



Final artwork must usually be supplied as:



* Editable Adobe Illustrator .ai file

* Print-ready PDF

* High-resolution PNG/JPEG mockup

* Fonts outlined where required

* Linked images embedded or supplied in a packaged folder

* Separate layers clearly named, including dieline, artwork, legal text, foil, varnish, and special finish layers where applicable



?



Ideal Person



You will be a good fit if you are detail-oriented, creative, reliable, and understand that label design is not just about making something look good. It must also be technically correct for printing.



We are looking for someone who can bring creative polish to our concepts while respecting the commercial, legal, and print requirements of alcohol packaging.



This could become ongoing work for the right person as MDG Beverages continues to develop new brands, products, collaborations, and limited edition releases.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Social Media Manager VA



Foothills Real Estate Media

Remote  | Part-Time to Start



Foothills Real Estate Media is looking for a creative, reliable, and detail-oriented Social Media Manager to help us stay consistent, creative, and intentional online.



We are a real estate media company based in Alberta, Canada. We create photography, video, drone, floor plans, 3D tours, and social content for realtors, builders, developers, and small businesses.



We are looking for someone who can help manage and create content for our brand, support our client-facing marketing, and bring ideas to the table instead of waiting for every tiny instruction like a nervous Roomba.



What This Role Will Help With



You will support the Foothills team with social media planning, content creation, and light marketing tasks.



Tasks may include:



-Creating Instagram posts, reels covers, carousels, stories, and simple graphics in Canva

-Scheduling posts and helping keep our content calendar organized

-Writing captions that sound natural, not like a robot discovered real estate yesterday

-Repurposing content from shoots into posts, reels, and story ideas

-Organizing client/project content for social media use

-Helping create simple marketing graphics, announcements, hiring posts, and promo materials

-Finding and saving inspiration from other real estate media brands, realtors, builders, and local businesses

-Helping with engagement, such as liking, commenting, and replying when appropriate

-Supporting outreach campaigns or Instagram research

-Keeping our brand voice consistent: professional, friendly, casual, and approachable



The Kind of Person We’re Looking For



We are not looking for someone who just “knows Canva.”



We are looking for someone who has a good eye, understands social media, and can help us show up consistently online in a way that feels polished but still human.



You might be a great fit if you are:



Creative and visually detail-oriented

Comfortable working independently

Strong with Canva and basic social media design

Familiar with Instagram, reels, stories, carousels, and content trends

Able to write captions in clear, natural English

Organized and able to manage recurring weekly tasks

Comfortable taking feedback and improving quickly

Proactive with ideas, instead of only waiting to be told what to do

Reliable with communication and deadlines





Bonus Skills



These are not required, but definitely helpful:



Experience with real estate, photography, video, or media companies

Experience managing Instagram accounts for businesses

Basic video editing skills for reels

Familiarity with Later, Meta Business Suite, Metricool, or other scheduling tools

Ability to create simple brand guides, templates, or content systems

Experience with lead research or Instagram outreach

Our Brand Style



Foothills is professional, but not stiff.



We like content that feels:



Clean

Warm

Modern

Friendly

Slightly casual

Helpful

Not overly salesy

Not overly corporate



We work with realtors, builders, developers, and small business owners, so the content needs to feel trustworthy while still having personality.



Schedule



This role will likely start part-time, with room to grow as we build trust and find the right rhythm.



Ideal availability:



Monday to Friday, flexible hours

Some overlap with Alberta business hours is preferred, but not required for every task.



Potential starting hours:



10–15 hours per week



This may grow over time for the right person.



Pay



Starting rate:



$5–$7 USD per hour, depending on experience and skill level.



There is room for growth as responsibilities increase and performance is proven.



Please apply and send PORTFOLIO.

title: Virtual Process Engineer (US Real Estate)
description:
Location: 100% Remote (Candidates must be based in the Philippines)

Job Type: Full-time (Starts with a 90-Day Paid Training Period)



About Us:

We are a US-based property management company operating with a deep commitment to Continuous Improvement and Lean principles, modeled after the Toyota Production System. We use specific training curriculums (including Moodle and Gemba concepts) to guide our operations. We are looking for a dedicated tea
mber to become an expert in our systems and help us improve our daily processes.



The Role:

This is a Junior-level virtual position ideal for recent graduates in Engineering, IT, or Computer Science. We know you may not have work experience yet; we are looking for someone with a logical mind who is ready to learn.



You will begin with a 90-Day Process Engineering Training Program. During this time, you will receive a training allowance while you learn our systems and methods.



Once trained, you will help us solve operational problems, research solutions, and organize our data. This is a hands-on role for a highly organized individual who enjoys structure and troubleshooting.



Key Responsibilities:



Learning & Research (First 90 Days): Your main focus initially is to complete our Moodle-based training curriculum. You will need to research concepts and apply them to our specific business case to show you understand how we operate.

Database Administration: Manage our NocoDB operational dashboard (similar to Airtable or SmartSuite). You will use your technical background to keep our data organized and efficient.

Problem Solving: Help us identify bottlenecks in our work. You will research why a problem is happening and propose logical solutions to the management team.

Process Documentation: Work with our US-based team to document how they currently do tasks, then help create Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to make those tasks easier and faster.

Performance Tracking: Help us track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and prepare simple reports that show how our improvements are working.

Qualifications:



Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Industrial, Civil, etc.), Computer Science, or Information Technology is preferred.

Experience: Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply. We are happy to train the right person.

Technical Skills: Comfortable learning new software quickly. Experience with databases or low-code platforms (like Airtable/NocoDB) is a plus.

Mindset: You should be curious, detailed-oriented, and enjoy fixing things.

Communication: Clear written English skills are essential for creating documentation and communicating with the team.

Discipline: As this is a remote role, you must be self-motivated and able to focus on your training modules from home.

Why Apply?



Training: Gain experience with Lean/Toyota Production Syste
thodologies—valuable skills for any future career in operations or engineering.

Growth: This is a career-track role. If you progress well, there is room to grow within the company.

Impact: You will be helping us solve real problems for a fast-paced real estate company.

About the Role:



We're looking for a driven and detail-oriented Product Development Manager to join our team and serve as the central engine behind product modifications, new size launches, and product line management across our portfolio of brands. This is a cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of product, sourcing, and brand — and the right person thrives in both strategic and hands-on environments.



You'll partner closely with our brand teams, business managers, and procurement specialist to take product changes from concept to completion — whether that's a new size, a material update, a formulation change, or a packaging overhaul. You'll own the full lifecycle of each project and keep all the moving parts aligned.



What You'll Do:



Product Development & Modification

Lead and execute product changes across multiple brands — including new sizes, format changes, material updates, formulation modifications, and dimension adjustments

Translate brand and business team requests into clear, actionable product specifications

Proactively identify opportunities for product line extensions or improvements across the portfolio

Review and approve spec sheets, prototypes, and samples to ensure they meet brand and quality standards



Portfolio Knowledge & Product Consistency

Maintain a deep, working knowledge of the full product catalog across brands — understanding what exists, what is in development, and how products relate to each other across sizes and variants

Proactively identify and resolve inconsistencies across the portfolio — for example, if one size of a product carries a benefit or feature that another size does not, you flag it and drive alignment

Audit product lines for discrepancies in specs, sizing, materials, formulations, or benefit claims and develop a plan to bring them into consistency

Partner with business managers and growth managers who own the catalog to ensure product development decisions are grounded in the full picture of what exists

Maintain organized records of product specs, supplier details, and project timelines to support cross-team visibility



Supplier & Procurement Collaboration

Work alongside our procurement specialist to source and qualify suppliers based on product requirements

Hand off supplier relationships once specifications are finalized, while staying engaged through launch to ensure alignment

Evaluate supplier capabilities against technical and brand requirements



Cross-Brand Coordination

Act as the central point of contact between brand teams, business managers, procurement, and operations

Manage multiple projects simultaneously across brands without letting anything fall through the cracks

Communicate project status, timelines, risks, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders

Sometimes you'll lead a project from scratch — other times you'll be handed a request and execute it. You're equally comfortable with both.



What We're Looking For:



Experience & Background

5–10 years of experience in product development, product management, or a closely related role

Background in CPG, food & beverage, manufacturing, or a combination of these industries

Proven track record managing product changes across multiple brands or product lines simultaneously

Experience working with suppliers and cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment



Skills & Abilities

Technically literate — you can read a spec sheet, understand materials and tolerances, and speak the language of manufacturing

Hands-on experience with packaging development — dimensions, materials, structural specs, and print specs are not foreign to you

Strong project management skills — you keep projects on track without micromanaging

Excellent communicator across all levels, from the factory floor to brand leadership

Highly organized with strong attention to detail, especially when managing a large catalog of SKUs

Self-starter who can identify what needs to be done without being told, but also executes well when given direction

Comfortable with ambiguity — you can figure things out as you go



Nice to Have

Prior experience supporting or working within a procurement function

Experience managing private label or multi-brand portfolios



Who You'll Work With

You'll be embedded in a collaborative environment where you interact daily with brand teams, business managers, and our procurement specialist. You won't have direct reports in this role — but you'll have significant influence across the organization. The right person for this role leads through expertise, relationships, and results.

title: E-commerce Customer Support & Operations Specialist
description:
Job Overview

We are a fast-growing Shopify direct-to-consumer (DTC) brand looking for a highly capable, sharp, and proactive E-commerce Customer Support & Operations Specialist. You will be a key part of our daily operations, acting not just as the voice of our brand to customers, but as an operational strategist who optimizes how we communicate and scale.



If you are someone who wants to just clear a queue and wait to be told exactly what to do every morning, this is not the role for you. We need an "operations-minded" builder who looks ahead, spots inefficiencies before they become problems, and takes complete ownership of our customer experience infrastructure.



Core Responsibilities

- Proactive Customer Support & Insights: Manage daily customer inquiries across
, chat, and social channels. Instead of just answering tickets, you will actively compile customer questions, identify friction points, and provide weekly feedback to management regarding what customers are actually saying.

- Commslayer Architecture: Take ownership of our communication stack. You will build out, organize, and optimize Commslayer to ensure our support workflows, automated triggers, and saved replies are firing seamlessly and efficiently.

- SOP Creation & Optimization: As you master our systems, you will document your workflows and build a comprehensive library of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). You are creating the blueprint for our support department to scale.

- Shopify Operations: Deeply manage Shopify admin tasks including processing order edits, managing complex cancellations, and issuing refunds accurately according to our policies.

- Cross-Functional Feedback Loop: Act as the bridge between the customer and the rest of the business. You will translate customer complaints or product ideas into actionable feedback for our product, marketing, and logistics teams.



Required Qualifications & Skills

- Shopify & Helpdesk Expertise is Mandatory: You must know the Shopify backend inside and out (orders, refunds, tags, app integrations) and have hands-on experience setting up macro workflows in modern helpdesks.

- Commslayer & Tech Savviness: Direct experience with Commslayer (or advanced proficiency in equivalent customer communication platforms) is highly preferred. You should be comfortable learning new software quickly and organizing digital workspaces.

- System-Oriented & Analytical: You don't just solve a problem for one customer; you think about how to build a system or write an SOP so the problem doesn't happen again. You know how to categorize data and spot trends in customer complaints.

- Exceptional Written English: Your communication must be professional, empathetic, clear, and perfectly aligned with our brand's voice.

- Proactive Mindset: You naturally follow up on unresolved customer issues, system bugs, or pending internal tasks without needing to be reminded.

- Reliable Setup: High-speed internet connection (with a backup plan) and a reliable, secure computer.

title: Operations Lead / Chief of Staff
description:
About the Role 



Reports to: Founder / Chief Revenue Officer 



Our client is seeking a highly capable Operations Lead / Chief of Staff with a Weekend Focus to support a fast-growing luxury short-term rental (STR) portfolio based in Austin, Texas. This individual will act as the primary operator during peak weekend hours, ensuring seamless guest experiences, rapid issue resolution, and continued operational excellence. 



The client currently manages a portfolio of 7 luxury properties and is on an aggressive growth path, with plans to scale to 20+ high-end properties by the end of 2026. The portfolio is currently trending toward approximately $80,000/month in gross rental revenue, requiring a high level of operational ownership, responsiveness, and attention to detail. 



As such, this role is best suited for candidates who have experience supporting STR portfolios or hospitality operations at a comparable scale and pace. Candidates should be comfortable operating in a high-volume environment where guest communication, vendor coordination, team coordination, project management, and operational decision-making happen simultaneously and often under time-sensitive conditions. 



This is not a basic VA role — this is a high-trust, high-impact position designed for someone who can think independently, problem-solve in real time, and help scale a premium hospitality brand. Over time, this person is expected to evolve into a true operator of the business for their shift, with ownership over systems, team coordination, operational execution, vendor management, and proactive business support. 



The ideal candidate will bring strong project management and chief-of-staff-level thinking, with the ability to oversee moving parts across operations, onboarding, vendor coordination, property launches, and internal team support. This role requires someone who can not only execute tasks efficiently, but also anticipate the needs of the business, identify potential issues before they arise, and proactively implement solutions that support long-term operational success. 

 



What You’ll Own 



Weekend Operations Leadership (Primary Focus) 

• Serve as the first line of defense for all guest communication and operational issues during peak windows (Thursday–Saturday). 

• Triage and resolve real-time issues (maintenance, guest concerns, vendor coordination). 

• Ensure a smooth handoff from weekday operations and maintain continuity of work. 

• Confidently make decisions in fast-paced, high-pressure situations without constant oversight. 

• Support preventative maintenance initiatives and proactively identify operational risks before they escalate into guest-facing issues. 

• Help anticipate operational needs across the business and proactively solve problems rather than operating in a purely reactive capacity. 





Guest Experience & Concierge Support 

• Deliver a high-touch, concierge-level experience aligned with luxury guest expectations. 

• Handle phone calls and messaging with professionalism, confidence, and exceptional English fluency. 

• Communicate clearly and professionally with U.S.-based guests and vendors across phone, text,
, and booking platforms. 

• Anticipate guest needs and proactively resolve potential issues before escalation. 

• Support high-value stays (e.g., ultra-luxury bookings) with exceptional attention to detail. 

• Represent the brand with polished written and always spoken communication. 



 

Systems, SOPs & Operational Scaling 

• Build, refine, and maintain SOPs and internal workflows to improve efficiency. 

• Identify gaps in operations and proactively implement improvements. 

• Assist in onboarding new properties (Airbnb, VRBO, Peerspace, etc.). 

• Support end-to-end property onboarding and operational setup, from design coordination and vendor scheduling to listing readiness and launch execution. 

• Utilize AI tools to streamline workflows, documentation, and communication. 

• Support the operational systems required to manage a rapidly scaling luxury STR portfolio with increasing booking volume and revenue complexity. 

• Assist in managing operational projects and ensuring execution across multiple moving parts and stakeholders. 

• Think strategically about operational scalability, process improvements, and future business needs. 

 



Vendor & Property Coordination 

• Coordinate with cleaners, maintenance teams, contractors, designers, and specialty vendors. 

• Troubleshoot issues and ensure timely resolution, especially during weekends. 

• Build and maintain a reliable vendor network and database. 

• Assist in sourcing and calling new vendors as the portfolio expands. 

• Develop and maintain strong vendor relationships to ensure high-quality service, responsiveness, and long-term operational reliability. 

• Oversee vendor coordination across multiple active properties and operational projects simultaneously. 

 



Team Collaboration & Leadership 

• Work closely with the weekday Operations Manager for seamless execution. 

• Support training, onboarding, and ongoing coordination of future tea
mbers and VAs as the business scales. 

• Help establish workflows, accountability systems, and documentation for internal team operations. 

• Contribute ideas and insights to improve systems, processes, and guest experience. 

• Operate with a high level of ownership, organization, and chief-of-staff-level support for the founder and broader business operations. 

 



Who This Role Is For  



You may be a strong fit if you:  



• Have STR Experience: You’ve managed or supported multiple short-term rental properties and understand the pace and complexity. 

• Have Experience at Scale: You have experience supporting STR, hospitality, or property management operations with substantial booking volume, multiple active properties, or revenue levels comparable to a portfolio generating approximately $80K/month in gross rentals. 

• Have Strong Project Management Skills: You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple operational priorities, stakeholders, vendors, and timelines simultaneously. 

• Think Like an Operator or Chief of Staff: You proactively support the business beyond assigned tasks, anticipate needs, improve systems, and help create operational structure as the company grows. 

• Have Leadership Experience: You are comfortable helping train, onboard, coordinate, and support other VAs or tea
mbers as operations scale. 

• Are a Proven Operator: You can independently run operations and make sound decisions without handholding. 

• Are a Problem Solver: You think critically, act quickly, and stay calm under pressure. 

• Communicate Exceptionally Well: You possess outstanding written and spoken English communication skills with a highly professional and polished communication style. You are confident handling live phone calls with U.S.-based guests and vendors and can represent a luxury hospitality brand professionally in all interactions. Strong English fluency is a firm requirement for this role. 

• Think Proactively: You anticipate issues and solve them before they escalate. 

• Are Tech & AI Fluent: Comfortable using tools and integrating AI into daily workflows. 

• Have High Standards: You understand luxury service and execute accordingly. 

 



Key Requirements 

• Experience managing or scaling multiple STR properties (required) 

• Experience supporting fast-paced STR, hospitality, or property management operations with substantial booking volume and operational complexity 

• Experience supporting portfolios operating at a comparable scale to approximately $80K/month in gross rental revenue is strongly preferred 

• Strong project management and operational coordination experience 

• Experience overseeing multiple vendors, operational timelines, and moving parts simultaneously 

• Experience training, onboarding, coordinating, or managing other VAs or remote tea
mbers 

• Ability to think proactively and anticipate operational or business needs before issues arise 

• Experience supporting end-to-end property onboarding, setup, or launch processes is strongly preferred 

• Excellent written and spoken English communication skills are required 

• Strong verbal communication skills with the ability to confidently handle phone calls with U.S.-based guests and vendors 

• Ability to write polished, professional, and guest-facing communication with minimal supervision 

• Background in luxury hospitality or concierge services (strong plus) 

• Experience managing or coordinating with tea
mbers or vendors 

• Familiarity with STR & operations tools: 

- Hospitable / HostBuddy

- Slack, Notion, Google Workspace

- PriceLabs, Breezeway

- Loom, Zapier, CRM tools 

• Experience with SOP creation, onboarding, and listings setup 

• Comfortable making phone calls to U.S.-based vendors and guests 

  



Preferred Qualifications 

• Experience in luxury Airbnb or high-end property management 

• Familiarity with QuickBooks or basic financial tracking 

• Experience supporting rapidly scaling operations 

• Strong systems-thinking and documentation skills 

• Experience serving in an operations manager, project manager, chief of staff, or similar operational leadership role 

• Experience overseeing property launches, renovations, design coordination, or listing optimization projects 

 



What Success Looks Like Within 90 days: 

• Weekend operations run smoothly with minimal founder involvement 

• Guest issues are resolved rapidly and professionally with high satisfaction 

• SOPs and workflows are actively improved and documented 

• Seamless coordination between weekday and weekend operations 

• Vendor relationships are organized, responsive, and effectively managed 

• New properties are onboarded smoothly with strong operational oversight 

• Founder has confidence that the business is fully supported during peak times 

• The business feels increasingly proactive, organized, and operationally supported rather than reactive 

 



Compensation & Schedule 

•Hourly Rate: $9–$15/hour (depending on experience with the potential for a performance bonus)   

•Schedule:   

- Primary coverage: Tuesday–Saturday to support key weekend operations while maintaining overlap with leadership and weekday operations 

- Approx. 25–30 hours/week   

- Some overlap with the Founder/CEO and weekday team for operational planning, systems development, and handoffs  

•Opportunity for increased hours and growth as the company scales

title: SEO & Authority Content Lead
description:
What ranks in two years matters more than what publishes this week.



A short pitch for who this is:



You play the long game. You've watched a single well-built piece quietly drive traffic for years. You've also watched companies torch their search presence by pumping out AI-generated noise because someone read a thread about content velocity.



You don't confuse output with strategy.



You can pull up a SERP and explain, page by page, what each ranking result is doing well and where the gap is. You think most "SEO advice" online is recycled and shallow, and you can argue why.



ABOUT SGEN



SGEN doesn't yet have authority in search.



Somebody Googling "WordPress alternative for agencies" in 2027 should land on a SGEN piece that's actually useful — not keyword bait.



Somebody Googling "why Elementor sites are slow" should find a piece that explains the cause honestly and only mentions SGEN where the mention earns it.



Somebody Googling "headless vs full-stack CMS" should find a comparison that reads like it was written by someone who's built both.



That's the work — building the search-and-authority layer that compounds over years, not months.



WHO FITS



You've done patient SEO before. The kind that takes 9–12 months to show its full effect and then stays for years.



You know the difference between a topic cluster and a content calendar.



You can talk through search intent, internal linking, and E-E-A-T without sounding like you got it off a
 thread.



You treat Ahrefs and Semrush as inputs, not gospel.



You can read three paragraphs of a piece and tell whether the writer actually knows the subject.



You'd rather publish ten strong pieces a year than fifty mediocre ones.



HAVE A REAL TAKE ON CONTENT STRATEGY



You probably have strong opinions about most B2B SaaS blogs. The 5-reasons posts. The 4,000-word ultimate guides that say almost nothing. The AI-generated round-ups that age in weeks.



You can articulate why most company blogs underperform: too much volume, too little point of view, no internal-link architecture, no respect for the reader's time.



You believe quality compounds and volume decays — and you can back it with examples from work you've done.



STEADY THROUGH SLOW MONTHS



Some pieces won't rank for months. Some will spike at six. Some will get quietly large a year after publishing.



You don't panic at month-one numbers. You don't pivot the strategy after one flop. You measure, wait, revise, re-link, and let the work do its job.



Search authority is a long conversation. You're comfortable in long conversations.



THE ACTUAL WORK



Topic strategy. Map the keyword and concept universe SGEN should own — WordPress alternatives, modern CMS, agency tooling, hosting-plus-builder-plus-CMS as one platform. Cluster it. Sequence it. Build a 12-month plan, not a 30-day calendar.



Long-form pieces. Write or commission the deep posts — pillar articles, honest comparisons, technical explainers, opinion-led essays. The ones that get cited, linked to, and quoted in newsletters. Voice support from Jerome; distribution support from the Growth Marketer.



Comparison pages. SGEN vs. WordPress. SGEN vs. Webflow. SGEN vs. Framer. SGEN vs. Squarespace. Real comparisons that acknowledge where SGEN isn't the right answer. That honesty is what makes the rest of the page credible.



Internal architecture. Design how the content links to itself. Keep the structure clean. Prevent the sprawl that wrecks most company blogs after year two.



Editorial bar. Set the quality standard for the blog and enforce it. Lighter, faster posts from the Growth Marketer are welcome on their own lane; the authority pieces all run through you.



Measurement. Organic traffic by cluster, rank position on target queries, organic backlinks, pieces that worked and didn't. Monthly read-out, honest, no vanity metrics.



WHAT WE’RE CHECKING FOR



- A portfolio with rankings. Pieces you wrote that ranked or drove traffic. If you can talk through why they worked, even better.



- English that reads native. Long pieces have to hold the reader. Every paragraph earns its place.



- WordPress and adjacent-CMS literacy. You don't need to be a developer. You need enough fluency in the ecosystem — plugins, builders, hosts, the actual pain — to write about it credibly. Webflow, Framer, Ghost, Shopify experience is a plus.



- SEO that isn't tricks. Topic clusters, intent, internal linking, durable on-page. You can also explain why most public SEO advice is shallow.



- A track record of compounding work. A small number of pieces still driving traffic years after publishing beats a large number that stopped working in three months.



- Sustainable cadence. One serious piece every two weeks, at this length, at this depth. Not faster. Not slower.



PROBABLY YOU IF



- You can name three SaaS blogs you respect and three you consider noise — with reasoning for each.

- You've personally written a piece still ranking a year later.

- You've watched a content program fail because somebody confused "publish more" with "build authority."

- You've rewritten an old post and watched its traffic multiply.

- You think most AI content is going to age poorly, and you can say why.

- You enjoy reading SERPs.



WHAT THIS ISN’T



It isn't a content mill.



It isn't four AI-assisted posts a week.



It isn't repackaging the docs as blog posts.



It isn't competitor comparisons where SGEN always wins.



It's a long-horizon search strategy run by somebody who's done it before and has the receipts.



WHY IT MATTERS



Search is the most durable acquisition channel a software company has access to.



Communities shift. Algorithms change. Ads get expensive.



A piece that ranks on a high-intent query, with real depth and an honest point of view, keeps working for years.



The right hire here plants the pieces that quietly carry SGEN's growth long after they shipped. The wrong hire here publishes volume that ranks for nothing.



COMPENSATION

$600-$650 USD per month



SCHEDULE

- 8 hour shift, Monday to Friday, 7:00AM to 4:00PM Philippine Time.

- Minimal overtime during weekdays and weekends will be expected as part of salary

What you build matters more than what you call yourself.

You don't run marketing through scheduling tools and call it a strategy. You read replies. You notice tone. You know which mod will nuke a link and which one will let it through if the comment actually helps.



You've sent cold
s that got real responses, and you can explain why those ones worked.



ABOUT SGEN



SGEN's product is solid. The voice is dialed. Docs are clean.



What's missing: a person who's in the room when WordPress users are venting, comparing options, asking the question that SGEN can answer.



When somebody posts at 1 AM about a plugin conflict that just nuked a client site, there's no SGEN reply in that thread.



When an agency owner asks Hacker News for a serious WordPress alternative, no one from our side shows up.



When a sandbox user signs up and goes quiet for two weeks, nothing reaches out.



That's the work. Daily presence — in communities, inboxes, and the funnel — done by someone who treats it as a craft, not a queue.



WHO FITS



You're patient with people and impatient with bad writing.

You think "automate the outreach" usually translates to "stop caring about the person on the other end."



You can read a thread and feel where the conversation is heading before it gets there.



You know community work runs on consistency, not bursts. You're prepared to be in the same places for months before they trust you.



HAVE A REAL TAKE ON WORDPRESS



Doesn't matter which way. Pro, anti, complicated — all fine.



What matters: you've used it enough to talk about it without faking. You can describe what people love about it and where it breaks down. When you bring SGEN into a conversation, it's because the conversation called for it — not because you had a quota.



People in those communities can tell the difference between somebody who knows the ecosystem and somebody running a script.



STEADY WHEN THINGS GET NOISY



Reddit will push back. Hacker News will be skeptical. Somebody will accuse SGEN of being vaporware, or worse.

You answer once, calmly, with substance. Then you let the comment do its work.

Communities. Reddit (WP-adjacent and agency-adjacent subs), Hacker News, IndieHackers, dev-focused

WHAT WE’RE CHECKING FOR



- English that reads native. US/UK readers shouldn't catch a translation feel. SGEN talks to a Western technical audience.

Real community track record. Two-plus years of being a regular somewhere — posting, replying, helping. We'll look at your account.

 that converted. Sequences you wrote, what you learned, what you'd change. Open and reply rates if you have them.
